name: Develop concepts and layouts for graphic design assets
description: Users asked for the creation or detailed guidance of various visual and graphic design assets, including posters, banners, flyers, business cards, and digital interfaces. The requests covered specific formats like print layouts, web graphics, and packaging, often requiring concepts, step-by-step instructions, or text content to accompany the visual designs.
